children: Lument Finance Trust regained compliance with the NYSE minimum $1.00 30-day average share price requirement.
NYSE notified the company on Oct 1, 2026 that a 30-trading-day average through Sep 30, 2026 exceeded $1.00.
The company’s common stock will continue to be listed and traded on the NYSE.
Continued listing remains subject to ongoing compliance with NYSE listing standards.
